body.role_description:
As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you will be the driving force behind the development and optimization of our cloud-based data platforms. Working at the intersection of business and technology, you will ensure that our data solutions are not only technically excellent but also provide real business value to our customers.

Using state-of-the-art technologies, you will develop robust data pipelines, ETL processes, and high-performance data models that enable scalable and efficient data utilization. Your goal: turning data into a strategic asset that empowers companies to make smarter decisions.

Your Responsibilities
  • Data Architecture & Development → Design and implementation of scalable data platforms using Microsoft Azure (Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL, Azure Synapse, Databricks)

  • ETL & Data Processing → Building, optimizing, and maintaining high-performance data pipelines with Databricks, Spark, and Kafka

  • Data Warehousing & Modeling → Developing robust data models and optimizing performance for efficient queries

  • Automation & CI/CD → Implementing CI/CD pipelines to automate deployments and testing

  • Collaboration with Business & Tech Teams → Close coordination with Data Scientists, Analytics Teams, and Business Stakeholders to develop data-driven solutions

  • Best Practices & Scalability → Ensuring our data solutions are sustainable, maintainable, and future-proof

Core Profile

AI / LLM Engineering

Backend & System Engineering

Data & Cloud

System Thinking

  • Can design agent orchestration flows, state handling, and sessions.

  • Thinks about latency, tool‑call minimization, and operational constraints.

body.role_description:
As a Senior AI Engineer (Forward Deployed), you are responsible for the hands‑on implementation of AI‑ and data‑driven solutions at domain depth.

You translate business processes, decision logic, and data flows into robust, scalable systems — ranging from agentic AI workflows to classical data‑engineering components (e.g. data layers on Databricks).

This role is hands‑on, AI‑first, and delivery‑focused, with strong ownership for technical quality, structure, and correctness.


Responsibilities

Domain Understanding

  • Understand and structure business processes, decision logic, and data relationships.

  • Challenge assumptions with customers and stakeholders.

  • Translate complex domain logic into clear, implementable solutions.


AI & Data Solution Implementation

  • Design and build agentic AI systems (agents, orchestration, tools, context, decision logic).

  • Build and evolve data‑engineering components (data layers, models, pipelines, semantic layers).

  • Combine agentic and data‑driven approaches into end‑to‑end solution flows.

  • Apply structured LLM orchestration, retries, fallbacks, and guardrails where appropriate.


Hands‑On Engineering & Quality

  • Actively implement core system logic (not a design‑only role).

  • Use AI tools to accelerate development, testing, documentation, and iteration.

  • Ensure maintainability, observability, and production readiness.

  • Take responsibility for reliability, monitoring, and cost awareness.


Customer & Team Collaboration

  • Lead technical domain workshops and solution sessions.

  • Work directly with customers at working level.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering Manager, Cloud AI Architect, and QA.

  • Contribute to architecture decisions and shared delivery ownership.
body.title: Senior AI Engineer (Forward Deployed)
